data.title: Data & Reset
data.description: Export a backup of your content, import a backup, or restore the original seed data. All content is stored in the database.
data.storageDesc: Projects are stored in the MySQL database via the Laravel API. The database is the single source of truth for the public /projects pages and this admin system. You currently have {{count}} projects.
data.exportDesc: Download the current projects as a JSON backup.
data.importDesc: Replace all projects from an exported JSON backup. This overwrites the current content in the database.
data.resetDesc: Permanently discard your saved changes and restore the original placeholder projects in the database. This cannot be undone.
data.invalidJson: That file is not valid JSON.
data.contentReset: Content reset to the original seed projects.
